cohort: 39,993 women who delivered live infants and stillbirths at 28 or more weeks of gestation at Kilimanjaro Christian Medical Centre (KCMC) hospital from July 2000 to December 2010
finding: Chronic hypertension, preeclampsia, prior caesarean section delivery, prior abruptio placentae, poor attendance to antenatal care and high parity were independently associated with abruptio placentae, which was associated with adverse maternal and foetal outcomes.
